verdict: One sentence at a time, centred, on a flat field; the field colour is the transition (sheet_1, sheet_2).
Handwritten green annotations (caret + word, arrows, parentheses) are the emphasis system instead of zooms or boxes (frames 0-116, 1144-1484).
Three colours only; green is never a background and an accent in the same shot.
Word timing follows the voiceover, so pacing feels spoken, not edited.

For DemoForge: the annotation-as-highlight idea works on real footage (caret + short word next to the clicked control); the colour-field swap transition works between beats. Avoid: no product on screen for 70 of 76 seconds.
evidence: contact sheets every 2 s + ffmpeg scene detection; media kept in scratch
